The analysis claims the data point '1996' was incorrect, but the provided text in Turn 7 never mentions 1996; it states 1969. Therefore, the error analysis misidentifies both the specific error and the nature of the failure (missing data vs. wrong data). While the resulting conclusion comparison remains valid, the diagnostic logic of the error analysis is flawed.
